description_en: Creates a media set by calling the CreateSet operation
name: CreateSet

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the media set. The identifier can contain only letters, digits, and hyphens (-).

If you do not set this parameter, the system automatically generates an identifier
parameters.help_zh:
媒体集的唯一标识，只能由英文、数字和短横线（-）组成。

如果未设置此参数，则系统会自动生成
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the media set. Chinese characters are supported.

If you do not set this parameter, the default value is empty
parameters.help_zh:
媒体集的显示名称，支持使用中文。

如果未设置此参数，则默认值为空
parameters.name: set_name

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the media set was created

FaceCount.description_en:
The number of faces in the media set.

This parameter is returned only when the media set contains face information
FaceCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的人脸数量。

当媒体集中存在人脸信息时，才显示此参数

ImageCount.description_en:
The number of images in the media set.

This parameter is returned only when the media set contains images
ImageCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的图片数量。

当媒体集中存在图片时，才显示此参数

ModifyTime.description_en:
The time when the media set was last modified.

After a media set is created, if the media set has not been updated, the modification time is the same as the creation time
ModifyTime.description_zh:
媒体集的修改时间。

创建媒体集后，如果未更新过媒体集，则媒体集的修改时间和媒体集的创建时间相同

SetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the media set

SetName.description_en: The display name of the media set

VideoCount.description_en:
The number of videos in the media set.

This parameter is returned only when the media set contains videos
VideoCount.description_zh:
媒体集中的视频数量。

当媒体集中存在视频时，才显示此参数

VideoLength.description_en:
The total duration of videos in the media set, in seconds.

This parameter is returned only when the media set contains videos
VideoLength.description_zh:
媒体集中的视频时长，单位为秒。

当媒体集中存在视频时，才显示此参数
